DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の防犯教室へご参加ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for the community crime prevention class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事が長引いて、開始より十五分遅れました。今から参加できるなら、途中までの配布資料を先にもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十五分遅着の教室参加と前半資料を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Work ran late, and I arrived fifteen minutes after it started. If I can join now, I would like the handouts for the part I missed first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you arrived fifteen minutes late and want to join the class and receive the first half's handouts. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 休憩後に入室をご案内できます。それまで、こちらで資料をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can show you in after the break. Until then, please look over the handouts here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 休憩までここで読みます。入口の扉を何度も開けるより、読んでいない最初の部分から準備したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休憩まで入口待機で冒頭資料を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll read here until the break. Rather than repeatedly opening the entrance door, I want to prepare by starting with the opening section I haven't read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait by the entrance until the break and read the opening handouts. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の資料は、地域で相談する時の用件の整理についてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's handouts are about organizing what you want to discuss when seeking advice in the community.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初のページに相談メモの見本があります。自分の個人情報を書いて提出する用紙ではなく、読みながら学ぶものですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談メモを見本で個人情報提出紙としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a sample consultation memo on the first page. This is something to learn from while reading, rather than a form where I write my personal information and submit it, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify that the consultation memo is a sample, not a form for submitting personal information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。見本としてお使いください。休憩が始まりましたので、後ろの席へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please use it as a sample. The break has started, so I'll show you to a seat at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後ろへ入ります。前半で答えが出た質問をすぐ重ねるのではなく、資料を読んでから最後の質問時間に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後方入室後資料を読んで最後に質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go in at the back. Rather than immediately repeating questions answered in the first half, I'll read the handouts and ask during the final question period.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that after entering at the back you will read the handouts and ask questions at the end. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの席です。配布物は二種類で、おそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your seat. There are two kinds of handouts. Do you have both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談メモの資料と連絡方法の案内を受け取りました。休憩後の説明にここから参加します。受け入れていただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二配布物確認で後半参加を受け入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the consultation memo handout and the guide to contact methods. I'll join the explanation after the break from here. Thank you for letting me join.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the two handouts and accept joining for the second half. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、再開まで席でお待ちください。教室をお役立てください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait in your seat until we resume. I hope you find the class useful. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 戻りの郵便物のご案内をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have the notice about returned mail, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先週私が出した手紙です。相手が受け取ったという連絡ではなく、私へ返す案内と分かったので取りに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人差出手紙の返送案内で受領希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's a letter I sent last week. I realized this was a notice that it was being returned to me, not confirmation that the recipient received it, so I came to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice concerns the return of a letter you sent yourself and that you want to collect it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の番号と、ご本人の確認資料を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the notice number and your identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。差出人には今の住所と名前を書きました。中には私が書いた便り一通が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内本人資料と差出人情報を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I wrote my current address and name as the sender. Inside is one letter that I wrote.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the notice, identification and sender information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。こちらが戻りの封筒です。返送理由の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked them. Here is the returned envelope. Please look at the stated reason for return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 理由の文字を読めました。今日は同じ封筒をすぐ出し直すのでなく、まず自分が戻りを受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返送理由を読みまず戻り受領を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was able to read the reason. Today, rather than sending the same envelope out again immediately, I'll first collect the returned mail myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have read the return reason and will first prioritize collecting the returned mail. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容物はご自身で確認してください。宛先に関するご相談は別に承ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the contents yourself. We can separately help with questions about the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で中身を確認します。相手へ届いたかだけ聞くのではなく、返ってきた理由を示して次の送り方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅内容確認と理由付き相手相談を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the contents at home. Rather than just asking whether it reached the recipient, I'd like to show the reason it was returned and discuss how to send it next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check the contents at home and seek advice about the recipient with the return reason. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取の確認をお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。案内の紙も封筒と一緒に保管し、前回発送済みの記録と今回返送された記録を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻り受領と前発送今返送記録を保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received it. I'll keep the notice together with the envelope and retain records of both the previous mailing and this return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm collection of the returned mail and keep records of the previous mailing and this return. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご確認のうえ次の発送をご相談ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check it and consult us about sending it next. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現金のご入金ですね。金額を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're depositing cash, correct? Let me confirm the amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三千円を入れます。家族から預かった物で、私の財布の五千円とは分けて持ってきました。全部を入れる依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族預り三千のみ入金し本人五千を残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm depositing three thousand yen. It's money entrusted to me by my family, which I brought separately from the five thousand yen in my own wallet. I'm not asking to deposit all of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you will deposit only the family's three thousand yen and keep your own five thousand. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入金する三千円はこちらの封筒にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the three thousand yen for deposit in this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、千円札三枚です。財布はかばんへ戻し、出す札をこの三枚だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三枚だけ提出し財布を戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, three one-thousand-yen notes. I'll put my wallet back in my bag and hand over only these three notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand over only the three notes and put your wallet away. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用紙の金額欄に三千円とご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write three thousand yen in the amount field on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三千円と書きました。家族へ後で渡すのは取引の控えですが、私の口座全体の情報まで知らせたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用紙三千記入と控え共有範囲を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written three thousand yen. What I'll give my family later is the transaction receipt; I don't mean that I want to disclose information about my entire account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you have entered three thousand yen on the form and explain how much of the receipt information you will share. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取引の控えに載る項目も、ご自身でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check for yourself what information appears on the transaction receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えを見て、家族へ日付と入金額を伝えます。今回の三千円を預かったメモにも、入金した日を書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えの日付額を家族へ知らせ預りメモへ入金日を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look at the receipt and tell my family the date and deposit amount. I'll also write the deposit date on my note about being entrusted with these three thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your family the receipt's date and amount and record the deposit date on the entrusted-money note. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご入金の確認を終えました。控えはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've finished confirming your deposit. Here is the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付と三千円を確認しました。財布の五千円は手元に残っています。家族へは今回の三千円の入金を報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三千入金と本人五千残を確認して報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed the date and the three thousand yen. The five thousand yen in my wallet is still with me. I'll report to my family that I deposited these three thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the three-thousand-yen deposit and that your own five thousand remains, and report it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、控えを大切にお持ちください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please keep the receipt safe. Thank you for using our services.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 焼きたてのパンをお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for freshly baked bread?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼食は済ませましたが、夕食まで少し長いので一つだけ食べたいです。この小さいパンは一個ずつ買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕食までの間食に小パン一個購入可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've already had lunch, but it's a while until dinner, so I'd like just one to eat. Can I buy these small rolls individually?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can buy one small roll for a snack before dinner. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは一個ずつ、隣の袋は四個入りでの販売です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are sold individually, and the bags beside them are sold in packs of four.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一個の方にします。今日はかばんが小さいので、四個入りを持って帰るより、その場で一個食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個売り選択と小かばんのためすぐ一個食べる希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take the individual one. My bag is small today, so rather than take a pack of four home, I'd like to eat one right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose an individually sold roll and explain that your small bag means you want to eat just one immediately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋にお入れします。温かいままお渡ししてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll put it in a bag. Is it all right to give it to you while it's still warm?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、外で食べるのでそのままで大丈夫です。持ち帰る四個袋とは違う買い方だと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: すぐ外で食べるため温かい一個受領を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll eat it outside now, so it's fine as it is. I understand this is a different way of buying from taking home a bag of four.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to receive one warm roll because you will eat it outside immediately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一個百五十円です。こちらでお会計できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: One costs one hundred fifty yen. You can pay here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二百円を出します。袋を開けやすいよう、持ち手をきつく結ばずに渡していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二百円支払と食べる際に開け易い袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give you two hundred yen. It would help if you didn't tie the bag handles tightly, so I can open it easily.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay two hundred yen and ask for a bag that is easy to open when eating. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 五十円のお返しです。パンはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is fifty yen change. And here is your bread.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五十円と一個を受け取りました。袋も開けやすいです。夕食までの間食が用意できたので、こちらを外でいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五十釣銭と一個と開け易い袋を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the fifty yen and one roll. The bag is easy to open too. Now I have my snack before dinner, I'll eat this outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm fifty yen change, one roll and an easy-to-open bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お召し上がりください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please enjoy it. Thank you very much.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: スタンプは、どこまで集まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many stamps have you collected so far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四つのうち三つです。最後まで回りたいですが、家族を迎えに行く時間なので、今日はここで終わりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四中三で迎え予定のため終了を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three out of four. I'd like to go all the way, but it's time to pick up a family member, so I'd like to stop here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have three of four stamps and want to finish because you have a pickup planned. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中で終えても構いません。参加の用紙は、お持ち帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's fine to stop partway through. You can take your participation sheet home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三つの記録を残して持ち帰ります。最後の所を通ったことにして押してもらうのでなく、未完了のままでよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未完了用紙を偽押印せず持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take it home with the record of three stamps. Rather than have you stamp it as though I'd visited the last place, I'm fine leaving it incomplete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will take the unfinished sheet home without a false stamp. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 完成の景品は四つそろった方への物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The completion prize is for those who have collected all four.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回は景品を求めません。三か所で見た物を楽しめたので、参加したことが全部無駄になったとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 完走景品を求めず三か所の体験を評価する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not asking for a prize this time. I enjoyed what I saw at the three places, so I don't feel that participating was a complete waste.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not ask for the completion prize and value the experiences at the three places. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかのお持ち物も、おそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have all your other belongings too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 用紙と筆記具を持っています。迎えの相手に遅れる連絡をするより、今出れば間に合うので予定通り向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙筆記具を回収し迎え時間を守る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my sheet and writing supplies. Rather than contact the person I'm picking up to say I'll be late, I'll leave now and make it on time as planned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Collect the sheet and writing supplies and keep to the pickup time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次にいらした時の参加条件は、その日の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check that day's guidance for the participation conditions when you come next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次回、今日の三つが使えるとは決めずに聞きます。今日は最後のスタンプを残して、公園を出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回引継可否を断定せず今日終了を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time I'll ask rather than assume today's three stamps can be used. Today I'll leave the last stamp uncollected and leave the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid assuming stamps can carry over next time, and decide to finish today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご参加ありがとうございました。それでは、お迎えにお気をつけて。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for participating. Take care on your way to pick up your family member. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の使い方について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about how to use the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が行き先を考えている間、私だけ買い終わりました。友人が決まるまでこの機械の前を空けずに待ってよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人購入済で友人未定中に機械を占有可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: While my friend is deciding where to go, I've finished buying my own ticket. May I stay in front of this machine without freeing it up until my friend decides?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can occupy the machine while your friend is undecided after you have already bought your ticket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 操作を終えた方は、次の方へお譲りください。お友達は、行き先が決まってから列にお並びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Once you've finished using it, please let the next person use it. Your friend can join the queue after deciding on a destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の切符は取れたので、横へ移ります。友人はまだ何も操作しておらず、途中の画面を残しているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入済移動と友人未操作を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my ticket, so I'll move to the side. My friend hasn't operated anything yet; we haven't left a transaction partway through on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will move after buying your ticket and that your friend has not operated the machine. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お取り忘れの切符や釣銭がないかも、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check that you haven't left any tickets or change behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切符と釣銭を取りました。自分の分を買ったことで友人の順番まで確保したと考えず、一緒に横で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券釣銭回収し友人順番を確保したとしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've taken my ticket and change. I won't assume buying mine secured my friend's turn as well; we'll discuss it together at the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Collect the ticket and change and do not claim that your friend's place has been secured. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行き先を決める案内図は、こちらでご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can look at the map here to choose a destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人はここで決め、次は自分の順番で買います。私が買い終わる前から後ろに人がいたので、その方へ機械を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内図で友人決定後に順番を取る計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. My friend will decide here and then buy on their own turn. Someone was behind me before I finished buying, so I'll free up the machine for that person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the plan for your friend to decide using the map and then take a place in the queue. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで待たれる間、通路を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the passage clear while waiting here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 壁側へ寄りました。友人の行き先が決まったら列の最後へ進み、二枚まとめて購入済みとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け友人列末尾と各購入状況を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've moved toward the wall. Once my friend decides where to go, we'll go to the end of the queue, and I won't say we have already bought both tickets together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the passage clear, have your friend join the end of the queue, and explain each person's purchase status. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご準備が済みましたらお並びください。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please join the queue when you are ready. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域施設へのご意見でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this feedback about a community facility?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 図書室を使って、入口の時計が見やすく助かりました。苦情ではなく、この短い感想を名前を出さず提出できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 時計への肯定的感想を匿名提出できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I used the reading room, and the easily visible clock by the entrance was helpful. This isn't a complaint; can I submit this short comment without giving my name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can submit positive feedback about the clock anonymously. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この意見箱では無記名でもお寄せいただけます。個別の回答をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can leave anonymous feedback in this suggestion box. Would you like an individual response?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 個別の返事は要りません。私が利用した時の感想として、一人分を書きます。同僚全員の意見とはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個別返答不要と一人意見の範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't need an individual reply. I'll write one person's impressions from when I used it. I won't present it as the opinion of all my coworkers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that no individual reply is needed and that the opinion represents one person only. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの施設か分かるよう、ご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write which facility you mean so we can identify it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 施設名と、昨日の夕方に利用したことを書きました。入口のどこから時計が見えたかも、短く添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 施設時刻と時計が見えた位置を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written the facility name and that I used it yesterday evening. I'll also add briefly where at the entrance I could see the clock from.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the facility, time and position from which the clock was visible. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お書きになった内容を、お手元で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check what you have written before submitting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口から時刻が見えると帰る準備をしやすかった、と書きました。営業時間を延ばす要求ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅準備の利点で時間延長要求と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written that being able to see the time from the entrance made it easier to get ready to leave. It's not a request to extend opening hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the benefit for preparing to go home from a request for longer opening hours. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの箱へお入れください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put it in this box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入れました。短い感想でも受け付けてもらえてよかったです。使う時に助かった具体的な点を伝えられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一枚感想を提出し具体的利点を伝えられたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put it in. I'm glad even a short comment is accepted. I was able to communicate a specific thing that helped me when I used the facility.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit one feedback sheet and say that you were able to communicate a specific benefit. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご意見をありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your feedback. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a walking stick?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会計の時に席へ掛けたままにしたようです。黒い杖で、持ち手に緑のひもが結んであります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 黒杖緑ひもの会計時置忘れを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I seem to have left it hanging on my chair when I paid. It's a black walking stick with a green cord tied to the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you left a black walking stick with a green cord when paying. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かりした物を確認します。今、一人で探しに歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the items we are holding. Can you walk around by yourself to look for it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩けますが、杖がないと不安なのでここで待ちたいです。受付の物を勝手に借りるのでなく、私の杖を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩行不安で待機し本人杖の照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can walk, but I feel uneasy without my stick, so I'd like to wait here. Please check for my own stick rather than my borrowing something from reception without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait because walking feels uneasy and ask them to identify your own walking stick. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 緑のひもが付いた黒い杖があります。ほかにご本人が分かる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have a black walking stick with a green cord. Are there any other features you can identify as the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下のゴムの横に白い小さな印を付けました。ひもは一周だけです。杖は折り畳む形ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ゴム横白印とひも折畳なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put a small white mark beside the rubber at the bottom. The cord goes around only once. The stick isn't a folding type.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the white mark beside the rubber, the cord and the fact it does not fold. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴が合っています。こちらでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Those features match. Please check it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 印もひもも同じです。私の物と確認しました。受け取ったらここで立ち、落着いて帰る準備をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 印ひも一致で本人杖受領を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both the mark and cord are the same. I've confirmed it's mine. Once I receive it, I'll stand up here and calmly prepare to go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the mark and cord match and that you are collecting your own stick. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに置き忘れた物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you left anything else behind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 眼鏡とかばんは持っています。杖を受け取り、先へ急ぐより持ち物をそろえてから出ます。見ていただき助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他持物と杖をそろえ落着いて帰宅する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my glasses and bag. I'll collect my stick and gather all my belongings before leaving rather than rush ahead. Thank you for checking; that helped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gather your other belongings and walking stick and calmly head home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お渡しできてよかったです。それでは、足元にお気をつけて。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad we could return it to you. Please watch your step. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様の連絡カードを、ご準備されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you preparing a contact card for your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもは自分の電話を持っていません。家族へ連絡する番号を一つ書き、子どもが読める形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話未所持の子に読める家族番号カードを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child doesn't have their own phone. I'd like to write down one number for contacting family in a way my child can read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a card with a family number that a child without a phone can read. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に使える連絡先を、ご家庭で確かめてお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check at home and write down a contact that can actually be reached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼に電話へ出やすいのは父です。私の番号だけを一番上へ書くより、父本人へこの用途を伝えてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 応答しやすい父へ用途承諾後に番号選択する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My father is the one most likely to answer during the day. Rather than just put my own number at the top, I'll tell my father what it's for before choosing his.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the number after telling the father who is likely to answer what it is for and obtaining his consent. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 子どもが読む時に、誰の番号か分かるようにしておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can make it clear whose number it is when your child reads it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「父」と大きく書きます。職場の番号ではなく、父が持つ携帯だと子どもへ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の携帯だと大字表示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write 'Father' in large letters. I'll explain to my child that it is his mobile phone, not his workplace number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use large lettering to show that it is the father's mobile phone. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 練習用の用紙は、こちらです。本当の番号をほかの参加者へ見せて練習する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is a practice sheet. You don't need to practice by showing the real number to the other participants.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 練習は見本の番号でします。家で本人の番号を入れる時は、父と一緒に一桁ずつ確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 公開練習は見本で実番号は家庭で父と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll practice using the sample number. When we put the real number on at home, I'll check it one digit at a time together with my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use a sample in the public practice and check the real number at home with the father. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードの携帯方法も、ご家庭で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also decide at home how your child will carry the card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どものかばんの内側へ入れます。外へ大きく番号を貼るのでなく、困った時に取り出せるか一緒に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内側収納と子が取り出せる方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put it inside my child's bag. Rather than stick the number in large letters on the outside, I'll check together with my child whether they can take it out when they need help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check a method for storing it inside the bag that allows the child to take it out. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご家族でご準備ください。教室へのご参加ありがとうございました。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please prepare it with your family. Thank you for joining the class. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 絵はがきをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for picture postcards?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。旅行中に会えなかった友人へ送りたいです。同じ絵を二人へではなく、それぞれに合う絵を一枚ずつ選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二友人向け各別絵はがき単売を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to send them to friends I couldn't meet during my trip. Rather than the same picture for both people, I want to choose one picture suited to each of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about individually sold picture postcards, with a different picture for each of two friends. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 山の絵と川の絵がございます。どちらも一枚ずつお求めいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have a mountain picture and a river picture. Both can be bought individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 山が好きな友人へ山を、散歩が好きな友人へ川を選びます。自分の記念用にもう一枚、川をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 山一川二を用途別に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll choose the mountain for my friend who likes mountains, and the river for my friend who likes walking. I'd also like one more river postcard as a souvenir for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose one mountain and two river postcards for their different purposes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 山一枚と川二枚、計三枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's one mountain and two river postcards, three altogether, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その三枚です。送るのは二枚で、自分の一枚は使わず残すので、三人分の便りではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三枚中送付二保管一の内訳を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Those three, yes. I'm sending two and keeping my own one unused, so these aren't messages for three people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that of the three postcards, two will be sent and one kept. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三枚をまとめてお渡しします。文面はこれからお書きになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll give you the three together. Will you be writing the messages now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、家で書きます。友人二人へは同じ文を写さず、それぞれと話した思い出を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後日各友人別の思い出を書きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll write them at home. Rather than copy the same message for both friends, I want to write memories of conversations with each of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to write different memories for each friend later. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計の後、こちらでお受取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please collect them here after paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三枚を受け取りました。自分用の川の一枚だけ手帳へ入れ、送る二枚は別の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三枚受領で本人一枚と発送二枚を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received all three. I'll put just my own river postcard in my planner and put the two to be sent in a separate bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the three postcards and separate the one for yourself from the two for mailing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ便りにお役立てください。それでは、よいご滞在を。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy using them for your letters. Have a pleasant stay. Thank you very much.
